cohort: The cohort consisted of 342 neonates suspected of clinical sepsis who were randomly included from the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of Jimma medical center (JMC) in Ethiopia.
finding: The study identified a high prevalence and mortality of neonatal sepsis at JMC, driven by a notable surge in antibiotic and multidrug resistance among isolated bacterial strains, particularly ESBL-producers.
